items.name: fl_cil_inspect
items.description: .NET Common Intermediate Language (CIL) and ECMA-335 bytecode inspector. Analyzes managed assemblies (DLL/EXE), extracts CLR runtime headers, metadata streams (#~, #Strings, #US, #GUID), module/type declarations, and disassembles CIL method bytecodes into mnemonic instructions.

items.name: fl_compare_managed_members
items.description: [Flowork RE: compare-managed-members] Compare managed PE/CLI member inventories by exact declared type, name, and signature; names alone never form a match

items.name: fl_import_managed_reconstruction
items.description: [Flowork RE: import-managed-reconstruction] Import decompiler-produced managed reconstruction against exact static member evidence

items.name: fl_inspect_managed_artifact
items.description: [Flowork RE: inspect-managed-artifact] Inspect PE/CLI identity without loading target code

items.name: fl_inspect_managed_members
items.description: [Flowork RE: inspect-managed-members] Inspect PE/CLI metadata members, signatures, and CIL anchors without loading target code

items.name: fl_inspect_managed_native_boundaries
items.description: [Flowork RE: inspect-managed-native-boundaries] Inspect PE/CLI PInvoke and native implementation boundary declarations without loading target code

items.name: fl_project_managed_application_graph
items.description: [Flowork RE: project-managed-application-graph] Project authenticated managed static Evidence into an application graph

items.description: [Flowork RE: verify-managed-native-boundaries] Verify managed P/Invoke declarations against authenticated native Evidence
